description: This file defines a CartFragment class for the Android app's shopping cart UI. It manages displaying cart items, total price, and a checkout button, observing cart data from ShopRepository.

classes.name: CartFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass managing the shopping cart UI, observing cart data, and handling checkout actions.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView, observes cart data for UI updates, and handles checkout button clicks.
